name: Extra Item Slot (2nd Slot)
displayDescription:
Carry one additional item into the game.
Unlock a second item slot and improve your chances of escaping the nightmare.

name: Extra Item Slot (3rd Slot)
displayDescription:
Carry even more items into the game.
Unlock a third item slot for better preparation — survival is still not guaranteed.
Note: If you purchase the third item slot before unlocking the second item slot, the second item slot will unlock instead. In that case, you can unlock the third item slot by purchasing the path to unlock the second item slot next.
